raw_result.summary: Complete-definition REVISE for one new tasks-owned verification defect. The plan16 constructor and AdmitAsync seam is now covered: T031/T032 precede T033/T034, name all mandatory proof inputs, and preserve closed restart and fresh cleanup authority. All seven hashes match. The SpecKit prerequisite selected this feature; deterministic plan/task validation returned zero errors, with all 36 required design IDs represented across 36 tasks and 17 completed markers preserved. Read-only semantic analysis found FR-001–FR-012 and buildable SC-001–SC-007 coverage, but the validator cannot detect that T032's real Windows security adapter lacks behavioral RED. Ordered prior raw plan reviews 01–16 and definition reviews 01–14 were compared; earlier findings remain resolved. Controlled host fakes, file-CAS fixtures and a reacquired mutex do not qualify selected-host protection or prior-generation native settlement. First-PATH restricted JDT, Story 18.3 ordinary-reader/native work and the prepared Repository remain separate dependencies. This verdict grants no implementation approval, resource permission or runtime readiness.
